course.narrative: The body is that of a well developed, well nourished Caucasian male stated to be 25 years old. Examination revealed extensive external traumatic injury, including a sharp force injury of the neck on the left side, which transected the left internal jugular vein. There were also injuries noted on the right side of the neck, and multiple superficial incised wounds on the face and other areas. The sharp force injury of the neck was opined to be fatal due to the transection of the left internal jugular vein.
